verdict.rationale: The pack shows a developer Platform API page for Audiences and a real-time API for user data, which suggests programmatic querying and audience work. However, the only documented activation flow requires the dashboard ('Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory'), and there is no MCP evidence. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating audiences, API-driven activation or connection to outputs without the dashboard, an MCP server, detailed customer-data query API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: Real-time API to drive user personalization
